### Kingly Conflict
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/kingly-conflict
Passage: Genesis 14:1-7
Points:
- This passage marks the Bible's first historical account of war between human kingdoms.
- Despite God's promise to bless the nations through Abram, fallen humanity continued to wage conflict.
- The coalition led by Chedorlaomer demonstrates the immense, crushing power of worldly empires over their vassals.
- Earthly powers and rulers are ultimately no match for God's covenant promises and His people.
- Christians living amid global turmoil can cast aside anxiety and find peace in Christ.
